kpis.label: Total footfall
kpis.description: All patient visits in this period = booked appointments + walk-in consultations.

kpis.label: Booked appointments
kpis.description: Appointments booked in advance through a channel (doctor portal, KEA portal, appointment agent) = in-clinic (2,518) + video / tele (104) consultations, as chosen at booking. Walk-ins are not included.

kpis.label: Direct walk-ins
kpis.description: Patients seen without a prior booking. Booked + direct walk-ins = total footfall.

kpis.label: Booked (clinic)
kpis.description: Booked appointments where the patient visits the clinic. Booked (clinic) + Booked (video) = booked appointments.

kpis.label: Booked (video)
kpis.description: Booked appointments taken as a video or teleconsultation. Walk-ins are physical clinic visits and are never video consults.

kpis.label: Avg consult time
kpis.description: Approximate: the mean appointment duration per visit across this period, not an exact measure of each consult.

kpis.label: Busiest day
kpis.description: The day of the week with the most visits across this period. A pattern over the whole period, not a single date; useful for staffing the right days.

kpis.label: Busiest hour
kpis.description: Approximate: the hour of the day around which visits peak across this period (a pattern over the whole period, not a single day).

kpis.label: Avg visits / day
kpis.description: Approximate, rounded to a whole number: total footfall ÷ number of days in the selected period.

kpis.label: Projected this month
kpis.description: A forecast is only meaningful for a current rolling period (last 7–90 days ending today). Select one of those presets to see the projected month at its daily run-rate.

doctorScorecard.note: Peer median cancellation rate is 3.2%. Doctors well above it are coaching candidates.

meta.bookingSourceNote: Booking source covers BOOKED appointments only (walk-ins have no booking). The explicit channel is used where recorded; otherwise the KEA sequence marks KEA-portal bookings, the legacy id marks migrated old-portal bookings, and a portal creator marks doctor-portal bookings. Website / symptom-collector / patient-app bookings arrive through the appointment agent.
meta.note: Sample data: this demo renders anonymized mock data captured from a test environment.
